data.name: Examination
data.description:
!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900

data.name: [🎃] The Veil
data.description:
"We can't fly, we can't walk on walls, we're weak we're only good at being eaten. And weaks can only make weak decisions."

🔱 A horde-based PvE & PvP MMORPG inspired by Mazerunner, Made in Abyss, and Terraria (Calamity Mod) 🔱

> Dive into an enormous labyrinth festering with an unknown evil
> Collect a multitude of weapons and items with varying rarities
> Engage in the slaying of massive hordes
> Deal with the danger of outlaws who don't seek order, but chaos in PvP
> Complete the story questline and end the evil that plagues this world

A game developed by Blackstar Studios ⭐

Available on all devices 🖥️📱🎮

data.name: Grave/Digger
data.description:
V.1.38
Only at death is the final chapter of our lives written.

When the surface was ravaged by war,
The Golden Empire and the Royal Nation continued their war underground.

An alternate history WW1 neo-western between two vitriolic factions with a near fully mine-able environment and a focus on slower, deliberate and considerate gun-play.

This game is enabled for Consoles but is not fully supported, some controls will not work, it is recommended to play with a mouse and keyboard.

vk/[NAME] to initiate a vote-kick (Press [L] for command bar).
/restoredata to restore Hours and Kills from the Beta Period.

Press [M] to open the in-game menu.
